# Hostname

`c.Hostname` calls the API's Hostname group. Get or set the hostname of target
hosts.

## Methods

| Method                                    | Returns                                 | Permission       | Description                   |
| ----------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------- |
| [`Get(ctx, hostname)`](#get)              | `*Response[Collection[HostnameEntry]]`  | `hostname:read`  | Get the hostname of the host. |
| [`Update(ctx, hostname, input)`](#update) | `*Response[Collection[HostnameResult]]` | `hostname:write` | Set the hostname of the host. |

### Get

```go
func (s *HostnameService) Get(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
) (*Response[Collection[HostnameEntry]], error)
```

Get the hostname of the host.

Reads the host's name as the hostname command prints it, on Linux and on macOS.
It makes no DNS lookup.

It sends `GET /api/node/{hostname}/hostname`, and needs the permission
`hostname:read`.

The examples of the method's definition:

A host named web-01, `go run hostname.go get`:

```go
resp, err := c.Hostname.Get(ctx, target)
```

### Update

```go
func (s *HostnameService) Update(
	ctx context.Context,
	hostname string,
	input HostnameUpdateInput,
) (*Response[Collection[HostnameResult]], error)
```

Set the hostname of the host.

Sets the static hostname with hostnamectl set-hostname, which keeps it after a
reboot. A host that already has the name does not change and reports changed:
false. It runs on the Debian family only, and elsewhere reports skipped. In a
container the runtime owns the hostname, so there it also reports skipped.

It sends `PUT /api/node/{hostname}/hostname`, and needs the permission
`hostname:write`.

The examples of the method's definition:

Rename a host, `go run hostname.go update`:

```go
resp, err := c.Hostname.Update(ctx, target, client.HostnameUpdateInput{Name: "web-02"})
```

A host that already has the name, `go run hostname.go update-2`:

```go
resp, err := c.Hostname.Update(ctx, target, client.HostnameUpdateInput{Name: "web-01"})
```
